credentials.description: Google Cloud project ID. Required for OAuth and service-account authentication unless baseURL is set.
Vertex location, such as us-central1 or global. Required for OAuth and service-account authentication unless baseURL is set.
Express Mode API key. Takes precedence over OAuth credentials; project and location are not needed.
OAuth access token sent as a bearer token.
Fallback for GOOGLE_VERTEX_ACCESS_TOKEN.
Service-account client email. Used with GOOGLE_PRIVATE_KEY when no API key or access token is set.
Service-account PEM private key; literal \n sequences are converted to newlines.
Optional service-account key ID added to the signed JWT.

notes: Gemini language, embedding, image, speech, transcription and Veo video models on Google Cloud Vertex AI. Authenticate with an Express Mode API key, an OAuth access token, or a service account; OAuth and service accounts also need a project and location.
